responsibility: This definition file is the declarative catalog of GCC optabs. It enumerates conversion, normal, direct, and overflow-aware operation tables; associates them with md pattern name templates, tree/rtl operation classes, and libcall-generation hooks where applicable; and thereby drives generated optab enums, initialization tables, and code-to-optab mappings used by the expander and target query layers.
same_name_distinction: This file is the declarative catalog for the optabs stem, listing optab kinds, pattern-name templates, and libcall metadata that drive generated tables and enums. Unlike gcc/optabs.cc it contains no expansion code, and unlike gcc/optabs.h it is not a public C++ interface header.
